title: Pachani Devi v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Dilip B. Bhosale, C.J. and Yashwant Varma, J.
disposition: Writ not pressed; liberty to CGRF under cl. 7.1; two-week decision
headnote: After the licensee pointed to the alternative remedy before the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum under Clause 7.1 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005, the writ was disposed of as not pressed with liberty to approach the Forum, which was directed to consider and decide any such application within two weeks of presentation.
facts: Smt. Pachani Devi filed Writ-C No. 2425 of 2017 against the State of Uttar Pradesh and four others. On 18 January 2017 a Division Bench recorded that the petition did not relate to recovery of any amount and directed that it be listed as a fresh matter before the appropriate Court. On 24 January 2017, before the Chief Justice's Court, counsel for the licensee respondents submitted that she had an alternative remedy before the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum under Clause 7.1 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

holding_units.topic: CGRF alternative remedy; writ withdrawn as not pressed
holding_units.holding: Where the licensee objects that the consumer has an alternative remedy before the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum under Clause 7.1 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and the writ petitioner withdraws with liberty to approach the Forum, the writ is disposed of as not pressed with that liberty, and the Forum shall consider and decide an application under Clause 7.1 within two weeks of presentation.

not_decided.point: Merits of the petitioner's electricity grievance
not_decided.note: The writ was withdrawn as not pressed after the Clause 7.1 objection; the Court did not examine the underlying supply or billing dispute.
